rule: the math lab's hypothesis intake reads these every pass and routes each to every tradition whose mathematics fits its mechanism, ranked by yield per compute-hour; an idea here is a QUESTION, never evidence -- every object it motivates meets the one compiler, Judge and ten-gate gauntlet

ideas.mechanism: floating storage of laden tankers off Norway with a weekly EIA crude-stock surprise: contango carry (storage build means oversupply, Brent weakens against WTI over 5 days) against pre-rerouting hoarding (Brent strengthens); spread drift after joint build events, net of 2x spread cost
ideas.falsifier: no sign-consistent XBR-XTI spread drift after joint build events net of 2x spread

ideas.mechanism: UK-Norway interconnector net export with an LNG outage flag: NOK revenue flow (NOK bid) against EU scarcity risk-off (EUR offered); decompose the EURNOK move into USDNOK and EURUSD legs on event days
ideas.falsifier: neither leg moves on event days beyond placebo days

ideas.mechanism: COT leveraged-fund gold positioning extreme (3y percentile) into the SGE benchmark hour 02-03 UTC: crowded-unwind reversal against momentum persistence; sign of XAUUSD 02-09 UTC return by pre-registered positioning quintile, point-in-time lag 3 days
ideas.falsifier: 02-09 UTC return sign is flat across positioning quintiles

ideas.mechanism: JP225 last-30-minute drift into the Tokyo close leads USDJPY 06-07 UTC: foreign-investor close hedging flow against a common risk factor; lead-lag controlling for the overnight US index return, placebo at 05:00
ideas.falsifier: lead-lag vanishes once the overnight US index return is controlled, or equals the 05:00 placebo

ideas.mechanism: London gold fix (10:30/15:00 UK) imbalance leads DAX/FTSE index drift over the next 60 minutes: bullion-bank physical-hedge rebalancing spills into equity-index risk against a common USD shock; partial lead-lag controlling the 1-minute dollar return, placebo at 10:00/14:30
ideas.falsifier: index drift after the fix equals the placebo-time drift once the dollar return is controlled

ideas.mechanism: China onshore CNY fixing surprise (PBoC mid against the model-implied fix) at 01:15 UTC leads AUDUSD/NZDUSD 02-06 UTC: policy-signal channel against the fix merely tracking overnight USD; regress on the surprise residual orthogonal to the overnight dollar, Holm over 2 pairs
ideas.falsifier: the surprise residual has no 02-06 UTC effect after Holm over the two pairs

ideas.mechanism: option-implied variance risk premium (implied minus realised variance, Black-Scholes/variance-swap view) from the CBOE VIX, GVZ and OVX tape in recorders/vol_archive.py: (a) insurance-selling compensation -- a wide premium is earned by short-vol holders and predicts calm forward drift and positive index returns; against (b) fear about to be realised -- a wide premium predicts the realised variance that follows. Separating test: regress next-5-day realised variance and next-5-day return on the premium quintile, point-in-time daily close, Holm over the three underlyings
ideas.falsifier: forward return and forward realised variance are flat across premium quintiles on all three underlyings after Holm

ideas.mechanism: Heston-style variance mean-reversion speed (kappa) estimated by rolling regression of daily realised variance changes on its level, used as a regime feature: (a) fast reversion means vol shocks are transient, so breakouts fade and mean reversion pays; against (b) slow reversion means persistent vol regimes, so trend continuation pays. Separating test: payoff of a fixed reversal and a fixed breakout rule split by kappa tercile, estimated only on data before each date
ideas.falsifier: the reversal-minus-breakout payoff spread does not change sign or size across kappa terciles

ideas.mechanism: jump-diffusion jump intensity (Merton/Bates-style; estimated as realised variance minus bipower variation on intraday bars) as an event-risk conditioner: (a) a high recent jump share signals scheduled-event or liquidity-gap risk that persists, so stops widen and intraday edges degrade; against (b) jumps are one-off and mean-revert, so the conditioner carries nothing. Separating test: next-day jump share and the hit rate of the desk's live intraday sleeves by prior jump-share quintile
ideas.falsifier: next-day jump share and intraday sleeve hit rate are flat across prior jump-share quintiles
